name: Colonial Hardwoods
old_description: Colonial Hardwoods has been a cornerstone in the lumber and building supplies industry since 1976. With over 50 years of combined experience, our team serving Washington, D.C., Maryland, Northern Virginia, Woodbridge, and Fredericksburg, VA, is committed to providing excellent customer service and high-quality products.
about:
Colonial Hardwoods has operated from Springfield, Virginia since 1976. The woman-owned small business began as a lumber supplier and has grown into a full-service woodworking resource for the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area, including Maryland, Northern Virginia, Woodbridge, and Fredericksburg.

The company stocks hardwoods, softwoods, exotic species, live-edge slabs, beams, timbers, decking, and cabinet-grade plywood. Its shop provides custom milling, cabinetry, millwork, stair fabrication, flooring, mantels, ceiling beams, butcher-block countertops, spray finishing, and wholesale molding and trim. Projects range from same-day small jobs to two-week turnarounds for larger work.

Customers include professional contractors, remodelers, cabinetmakers, furniture builders, and DIY enthusiasts across residential and light commercial construction. The firm also supplies wholesale lumber to other woodworking businesses.

Colonial Hardwoods emphasizes its five-decade track record, same-day service on small projects, and build-assistance consulting as key differentiators. The ownership cites deep industry knowledge and a commitment to customer satisfaction as the foundation of its longevity.

name: Colorado Style Home Furnishings & Interior Design | Bedroom Furniture | Living Room Furniture | Denver Furniture Store
old_description: Colorado Style Home Furnishings, family owned and operated since 1993, is a leader in the fine furniture retail industry and one of Denver’s top furniture stores. We are located in South Denver, at E County Line Rd (C-470) and University Blvd (CO-177) in the same parking lot as the Olive Garden. Specializing in top quality furniture and accessories, Colorado Style Home Furnishings has two showrooms that offer over an acre of luxury reclining furniture, living room furniture, leather furniture, bedroom furniture and patio furniture. We have the best selection of top quality brands at the best prices in town. Let our design experts help you make your house a home. Visit our furniture store in Denver CO for great furniture today!
about:
Colorado Style Home Furnishings operates from two adjacent showrooms on East County Line Road in Highlands Ranch, Colorado, a southern suburb of Denver. The family-owned business was founded in 1993 and has grown into one of the Denver area’s largest independent furniture retailers.

The company stocks over an acre of floor space with living-room, bedroom, dining-room, home-office and outdoor furniture, plus accessories such as rugs, lighting and bedding. Inventory emphasizes reclining and leather upholstery, and the retailer carries multiple brand-name lines. Complimentary interior-design consultation is offered both in-store and through an online room-planning tool.

Primary customers are residential homeowners throughout the Front Range, though a “To the Trade” program also serves interior designers and specifiers. The showrooms are open seven days a week, and the company advertises immediate delivery on in-stock items.

The founders positioned the business on a combination of broad selection, competitive pricing and design expertise, aiming to help customers “make your house a home” without the pressure of commission-driven sales.

name: Columbine Plastics Corp. Full Service Custom Injection Molding
old_description: Columbine Plastics will work with you to refine your design to reduce tooling or part costs and enhance manufacturing and repeatability. We are experts in materials and we have the most sophisticated prototyping capabilities in the industry.
about:
Columbine Plastics Corp. operates from Louisville, Colorado, as a custom injection molding and moldmaking specialist. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides custom plastic injection molding, precision moldmaking, laser sintering, and rapid tooling. Its moldmaking capabilities range from low-cost aluminum tools to multi-cavity hot runner, three-plate, and laser-sintered mold systems. Columbine works with exotic, difficult-to-run polymers such as PEEK and Ultem, and reports supplying over 100,000 components annually. An experienced quality assurance team reviews dimensional and cosmetic requirements before production.

Customers include industrial equipment manufacturers such as Caterpillar Tractor Company and high-technology suppliers like Litton Industries. The company serves sectors requiring critical high-technology components and precision replication for demanding applications.

Columbine emphasizes design collaboration to reduce tooling and part costs while improving manufacturability and repeatability. It positions its prototyping capabilities as among the most sophisticated in the industry and stresses consistent replication of precision parts at competitive pricing.

about:
Columbus Woodworks operates from Lynchburg, Virginia, where it has manufactured custom wood storm doors and screen doors since 1991. The company was incorporated as Columbus Woodworks, Inc., and has built a reputation as a quality‑oriented manufacturer serving both residential and commercial markets.

The facility functions as a full‑service architectural woodwork and millwork shop, providing complete design‑and‑build services along with installation. Its core product lines include custom‑size storm doors and screen doors with removable glass or screen panels, as well as historical restoration and reproduction work for residential, commercial, and institutional projects.

Customers range from homeowners ordering single doors online to builders and architects specifying millwork for larger projects. The company’s online configurator allows buyers to design custom storm and screen doors directly, while its restoration services cater to historic preservation projects.

Columbus Woodworks emphasizes its online custom‑door building capability as a key differentiator, enabling customers to specify dimensions, styles, and options without visiting a showroom. Recent supply‑chain disruptions have extended lead times for custom doors with removable panels to six weeks or more, a constraint the company communicates upfront.

name: Commercial Food Service
old_description: We offer a wide selection of professional restaurant supplies, perfect for home chefs and restauranteurs. From cookware and bakeware to utensils and gadgets, we have everything you need to equip your kitchen for success.
about:
Commercial Food Service operates from Odessa, Texas, where it was founded in 2006 as a family-owned restaurant supply and equipment dealer. The company serves the greater Midland–Odessa area and the broader Permian Basin region from a cash-and-carry showroom that is open to the public.

The business stocks and sells commercial kitchen equipment including dishwashers, ice machines, kitchen hoods, walk-in coolers and freezers, and a wide range of restaurant smallwares such as flatware, dishware, utensils, and serving pieces. Beyond product sales, it provides full-service installation, replacement, and 24/7 repair for the equipment it sells, as well as knife sharpening. A dedicated design team handles commercial kitchen layout, configuration, and permit-approval assistance for new builds and renovations.

Customers include independent restaurants, hotels, churches, institutional kitchens, and home chefs throughout the Permian Basin. The company cites long-standing relationships with local foodservice operators and positions itself as a one-stop shop for both supplies and project support.

Leadership emphasizes responsive service, competitive pricing, and the convenience of bundled design, procurement, and installation under one roof. The 24-hour technician availability and permit-handling support are highlighted as key reasons customers choose the firm.

name: Commercial Furniture Company
old_description: Jenni Muñiz, founder of Commercial Furniture Co., is a Scottsdale office furniture expert serving the Phoenix metropolitan area since 2021. Combining strategic business insight with refined design expertise, Jenni has grown the company into a trusted source for office furniture, cubicles, ergonomic chairs, standing desks, and complete workspace solutions for small and mid-sized businesses.
about:
Commercial Furniture Company was founded in 2021 in Scottsdale, Arizona, by Jenni Muñiz. A family-owned and locally operated business, it began with Muñiz’s background in marketing and project management after graduating from Arizona State University’s Walter Cronkite School of Journalism. She set out to help Arizona businesses succeed by creating high-performing commercial spaces that balance form, function, and budget.

The company operates as a full-service commercial furniture dealer, providing furniture procurement, space planning, interior design, project management, installation and moving, warranty service management, and financing. It leverages partnerships with North American contract-grade furniture manufacturers to supply cubicles, private offices, ergonomic chairs, standing desks, and complete workspace solutions. A quick-ship catalog offers fast, budget-sensitive options. The firm coordinates logistics from multiple manufacturers, handles permits, and manages vendor payments, serving the Phoenix metropolitan area.

Clients range from small and mid-sized businesses to medical facilities, hospitality venues, senior living centers, behavioral health organizations, multi-family housing, community clubhouses, and golf resorts. Notable projects include a brewery in Gilbert, Arizona, and various medical offices throughout Scottsdale, Phoenix, Mesa, Gilbert, Chandler, and surrounding communities.

The company emphasizes value engineering, integrity, cooperation, empathy, and efficiency. Its stated differentiator is rethinking the furniture purchasing system to deliver superior-quality products quickly at affordable prices, backed by a family-first approach and a network of local designers, architects, and contractors.

name: Connecticut Hypodermics Inc
old_description: We are the leading manufacturer of precision custom hypodermic needles and other related components for medical devices. Connecticut Hypodermics' skilled engineering staff continually develops innovative manufacturing solutions to produce products in the most efficient manner, and we've done it, year after year, with the most consistent, reliable and cost-effective results possible.
about:
Connecticut Hypodermics Inc. was founded in 1979 and is based in Wallingford, Connecticut, with its facility located in the Yalesville area. The company has operated continuously since its inception, building a reputation for precision needle manufacturing.

The company specializes in precision custom hypodermic needles and related components for medical devices. Its capabilities span a wide range of fabrication and assembly processes, including automatic and manual assembly, mechanical crimping, ring staking, epoxy bonding, bending, centerless grinding, cleaning and passivation, EDM machining, electrolytic cutting, laser marking, swaging, tube forming, welding, and more. The engineering staff develops custom manufacturing solutions to produce parts efficiently at varying volumes.

Connecticut Hypodermics serves the medical device industry, supplying original equipment manufacturers and component suppliers who require high-precision needle products. The company’s customer base includes firms developing surgical instruments, diagnostic equipment, and other healthcare technologies that demand tight tolerances and biocompatible materials.

The firm differentiates itself through a commitment to meeting challenging customer requirements with innovative manufacturing approaches. It emphasizes consistent, reliable, and cost-effective results, backed by ISO 13485:2016 certification and a focus on quality precision across all operations.

name: Container Supply
old_description: Container Supply, Inc. is a leading provider of quality packaging containers nationwide.  Our products are well suited for industrial markets such as petroleum, paint & coatings, chemical, food & beverage, and environmental industries.
about:
Container Supply, Inc. was founded in 1969 in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. In June 2021, the company was acquired by Kelso & Company and became part of Novvia Group, a national packaging distributor with a family of companies across North America.

The company operates as a rigid container and packaging distributor, supplying steel drums, fibre drums, plastic drums, pails, tubs, bottles, jars, HazMat containment, tinplate cans, steel pails, glass bottles and jars, closures, sprayers, and accessories. It maintains a 50,000‑square‑foot warehouse in Oklahoma City and runs a fleet of delivery trucks to support just‑in‑time stocking programs. Value‑added services include custom mold design, decoration (silk‑screening, offset printing, sleeve‑labeling, and lithography), and tailored delivery.

Container Supply serves industrial markets such as petroleum, paint and coatings, chemical, food and beverage, food and drug, and environmental sectors. Its customers range from large‑volume users requiring multiple truckloads to smaller buyers needing only a few containers.

The business emphasizes reliable, economical delivery backed by a large local inventory and a focus on customer service, positioning itself as a partner that helps clients find the right packaging solution quickly.

name: Cooper Fabrication Inc.
old_description: , founded in 2002, is a family run, full service welding, repair and fabrication business. With our shop in Post Falls, Idaho, and several fully equipped mobile and support equipment units, we are able to service all of Coeur d’Alene and Kootenai County, as well as the rest of North Idaho, Spokane and Eastern Washington.
about:
Cooper Fabrication Inc. was founded in 2002 in Post Falls, Idaho, as a family-run welding, repair, and fabrication shop. The company operates a brick-and-mortar facility in Post Falls and deploys several fully equipped mobile units to serve customers across Coeur d’Alene, Kootenai County, greater North Idaho, Spokane, and eastern Washington.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication and welding in carbon steel, aluminum, and stainless steel using MIG, TIG, and stick processes. Core services include portable line boring and bore welding for heavy machinery repair, custom fabrication for trucks, trailers, gates, handrails, and marine components, as well as commercial, industrial, residential, and agricultural work. The facility is supported by a large fabrication shop and mobile units that enable on-site repairs and installations.

Customers span heavy equipment operators, trucking fleets, construction firms, farms, and residential clients throughout the Inland Northwest. The company holds contractor licenses in both Idaho and Washington, carries full insurance, and employs certified welders. It also acts as an authorized dealer for SnowDogg plows, B&W trailer hitches, and SwapLoader hook-lift systems.

The owner brings 30 years of fabrication and design experience, and the business emphasizes high-quality work completed on schedule at a reasonable cost. The combination of in-shop capacity and mobile response is presented as a key differentiator for clients needing rapid turnaround on repairs or custom builds.
